note: Extensible starting coverage, not an exhaustive catalog of every industry, vendor or statutory process. Industry labels are Studio categories, not an official NACE/NIC code crosswalk.

regions.name: Global / decide later
guidance: Use the shared operational process. Do not infer country, currency, tax, employment or retention policy.

regions.name: European Union
guidance: Identify the member state before adding country-specific statutory rules.
Use NACE as a source for industry classification, not an executable business workflow.
VAT identification and invoice requirements need the applicable country and transaction context; do not insert a universal VAT rate.

sources.title: Eurostat NACE overview
sources.scope: Industry classification reference; not a workflow approval.

sources.title: European Commission VAT identification numbers
sources.scope: VAT identification reference; no tax calculation or threshold is encoded.

regions.name: India
guidance: Identify the state and operating context before adding country-specific statutory rules.
Use NIC as a source for industry classification; Studio industry categories are not official NIC mappings.
GST and electronic-invoice integrations require customer applicability review and current official rules; no tax rate or turnover threshold is assumed.

sources.title: MoSPI NIC 2008 code finder
sources.scope: Classification source link; detailed classifications need source review.

sources.title: GST e-Invoice portal
sources.scope: Official portal reference; automated retrieval returned 403, rules not ingested.
